# TypingIndicator

Show between the visitor's message and the reply, so the pause reads as "thinking", never as "broken".

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.TypingIndicator` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.TypingIndicator />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.TypingIndicator"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Three pulsing dots in a Aleem bubble while a reply is being composed.

## Props (TypingIndicatorProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Announced to screen readers. @default "Aleem is typing" |
| `showAvatar` | `boolean` | @default true |
| `avatar` | `'assistant' \| 'aiux' \| 'cory'` | Avatar kind of whoever is typing. @default "cory" |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
